name: Open an issue
about: A wrong answer, something missing, an outcome to aim at, or upkeep. The kind is decided at triage — say what happened, not what to call it.
title: ''
assignees: ''

---

<!--
No kind to choose. Whoever triages this reads what you wrote and sets the type — Bug, Feature,
Goal or Maintenance — because the same report can be any of them depending on what turns out to be
true. Fill in what you know and leave the rest; a blank issue is fine too.

Questions belong in Discussions: https://github.com/asc-community/AngouriMath/discussions
-->

**What you ran**: <!--
The expression or the code, as you ran it, so it can be pasted in. `"x^2".Integrate("x")` is
enough; a screenshot of the same is harder to run. Say which package and version if you know it --
AngouriMath, AngouriMath.FSharp, AngouriMath.Interactive or AngouriMath.CPP.
-->

**What it did**: <!--
The answer it gave, the exception, the hang -- or "nothing, it is not there".
-->

**What it should have done**: <!--
The answer you expected, and where that comes from if it is not obvious: a textbook, another
system, a definition. For something that does not exist yet, what should be true once it does.
-->
